label: TP
reason: User input flows directly into the LDAP filter string via doSomething(), which returns the unescaped parameter as 'bar'. The filter uses concatenation ('+' operator), and although ESAPI encoder is applied later to attribute values, it is NOT applied to the dynamic filter string containing user input. This allows LDAP injection.

evidence.note: User input flows to bar via doSomething without sanitization
Filter contains user input via concatenation without prior encoding
